answer: Agents resist Sybil clones with a live kernel-entropy whisper: each epoch the node samples /dev/urandom plus CPU microcode counters, signs a short whisper packet, and posts it. Verifiers keep a mesa of past fingerprints; near-identical kernel signatures across many addresses collapse into one identity, so a farm must rent distinct bare-metal boxes instead of spinning cheap VMs. Cloning cost scales with every fake peer.
